age_limit.details: Upper age limit is not more than 40 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

qualification.details: Candidate must be a citizen of India. | Two years’ experience of translation work from Hindi to English and vice versa in a Central / State Government Office/PSUs/Autonomous Body/Large and reputed Organization. | The candidate should have excellent written and oral communication and interpersonal skills. Knowledge of Computer applications such as MS word, MS Excel, Power point etc. are essential.

salary_details.details: Consolidated Rs. 50000/- Per month, which shall be enhanced 10% per year. No other allowances shall be admissible. Company Quarter will be provided, if available and necessary deduction will be made as per Company Rules.

selection_process: Selection on the basis of Educational Qualification
Experience and performance in personal Interview. The interview will be conducted by a duly constituted selection committee.
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from the official website www.aweil.in or ddpdoo.gov.in.
Fill in all relevant information such as qualifications, experience, percentage of marks, email address, contact mobile number, address for correspondence, AADHAR number/PAN number.

Affix one recent passport-size photograph (4.4 cm x 5.8 cm) in the space provided on the application and sign across the photo. Keep the second passport-size photograph attached with full name written on the backside.

Ensure candidates working in Govt./Public Sector forward their application through proper channel or submit an NOC at the time of interview.

Send the hard copy of the application via speed post or courier service to: DIRECTOR (HR), Advanced Weapons and Equipment India Limited, Ordnance Factory Kanpur premises, Kapli Road, Kanpur UP -208009.
important_instructions: Only hard copy of the application is acceptable; applications not in the prescribed format or incomplete will be summarily rejected. Working hours will be as per AWEIL HQ; employees may be required to attend office on Saturdays or holidays without additional compensation if work exigencies demand.

content_sections.heading: AWEIL Junior Translator Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Translator post.

content_sections.heading: AWEIL Junior Translator Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidate must be a citizen of India. Two years’ experience of translation work from Hindi to English and vice versa in a Central / State Government Office/PSUs/Autonomous Body/Large and reputed Organization. The candidate should have excellent written and oral communication and interpersonal skills. Knowledge of Computer applications such as MS word, MS Excel, Power point etc. are essential.

rows.qualification_required: Master’s degree of a recognized University in Hindi with English as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level; OR Master’s degree of a recognized University in English with Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at the degree level; AND Diploma or certificate course in translation from Hindi to English and vice versa from any Recognized Institute.

content_sections.heading: AWEIL Junior Translator Age Limit
content_sections.text: Upper age limit is not more than 40 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

content_sections.heading: AWEIL Junior Translator Salary
content_sections.text: Consolidated Rs. 50000/- Per month, which shall be enhanced 10% per year. No other allowances shall be admissible. Company Quarter will be provided, if available and necessary deduction will be made as per Company Rules.

content_sections.heading: AWEIL Junior Translator Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection on the basis of Educational Qualification, Experience and performance in personal Interview. The interview will be conducted by a duly constituted selection committee.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AWEIL Junior Translator
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the official website www.aweil.in or ddpdoo.gov.in. Fill in all relevant information such as qualifications, experience, percentage of marks, email address, contact mobile number, address for correspondence, AADHAR number/PAN number. Affix one recent passport-size photograph (4.4 cm x 5.8 cm) in the space provided on the application and sign across the photo. Keep the second passport-size photograph attached with full name written on the backside. Enclose self-attested copies of documents/certificates in support of age, qualification, experience, etc. Ensure candidates working in Govt./Public Sector forward their application through proper channel or submit an NOC at the time of interview. Superscribe the envelope with “APPLICATION FOR THE POST “Junior Translator” . Send the hard copy of the application via speed post or courier service to: DIRECTOR (HR), Advanced Weapons and Equipment India Limited, Ordnance Factory Kanpur premises, Kapli Road, Kanpur UP -208009 .

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Two self-attested recent passport photographs with full name on the backside Self-attested copies of age proof (Birth Certificate / 10th Class Certificate) Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates Self-attested copies of experience certificates NOC from employer (if working in Govt./Public Sector)

content_sections.heading: AWEIL Junior Translator Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only hard copy of the application is acceptable; applications not in the prescribed format or incomplete will be summarily rejected. Applications must reach on or before 31/10/2026; management will not take responsibility for postal delays or transit loss. The appointment is purely temporary and on contract basis for an initial period of 01 year, extendable up to 03 years. Services can be terminated by AWEIL by giving 1-month notice or salary in lieu thereof, while candidates leaving must give 3 months' notice or salary in lieu. The contract does not confer any right or claim of extension or absorption in the company. New Labour codes will be applicable to newly engaged contract employees. Working hours will be as per AWEIL HQ; employees may be required to attend office on Saturdays or holidays without additional compensation if work exigencies demand.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this notification?
faq.answer: Advanced Weapons & Equipment India Limited (AWEIL) is recruiting for this post.

faq.question: Q2. What post is being advertised?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications for the post of Junior Translator.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available, which is unreserved (UR).

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 31/10/2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s degree in Hindi with English as a subject or Master’s degree in English with Hindi as a subject, along with a diploma or certificate course in translation from Hindi to English and vice versa.

faq.question: Q6. Is experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates need two years’ experience of translation work from Hindi to English and vice versa in a Central/State Government office, PSU, Autonomous Body, or large and reputed organization.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not more than 40 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month, which shall be enhanced by 10% per year.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their application in hard copy via speed post or courier service to the designated address at Kanpur.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent position?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary and on a full-time contract basis for 1 year, extendable up to 3 years.
